paper.abstract_en: Considering a cylindrically symmetric spacetime, a novel exact $κ$-deformed Schwarzschild-AdS black string solution is derived in General Relativity in the presence of a negative cosmological constant. The geometric properties of the resulting solution are systematically investigated by computing the Ricci and Kretschmann curvature scalars. The analysis reveals the existence of a curvature singularity at the origin, which remains enclosed by an event horizon provided that the $κ$-deformation parameter satisfies a specific constraint. Subsequently, the influence of various model parameters on the horizon structure and configuration is examined in detail. The thermodynamic properties of these black strings are thoroughly evaluated; in this regard, the Hawking temperature, entropy, mass, isobaric heat capacity, and Gibbs free energy are self-consistently extracted. The effects of the parameters, particularly the $κ$-deformation parameter, on these thermodynamic quantities are comprehensively explored. Furthermore, it is demonstrated that these state variables fundamentally satisfy the extended first law of black hole thermodynamics and yield a modified Smarr relation. Finally, the temporal profile of the Hawking radiation is probed via the dimensionless sparsity parameter, through which the impacts of the underlying parameters on the quantum emission rate are systematically analyzed.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文推导了κ-变形的Schwarzschild-AdS黑弦精确解，系统分析了几何性质、奇点与视界结构，并自洽地提取了Hawking温度、熵、质量、等压热容与Gibbs自由能，验证了扩展第一定律并给出修改的Smarr关系，最后通过稀疏度参数探讨Hawking辐射的量子发射率。理论深度、方法 rigor 与清晰度均较强，与黑洞热力学主题高度相关。
decision.abstract_zh: 考虑柱对称时空，在存在负宇宙学常数的情况下，于广义相对论中推导出一个新的精确$\kappa$-变形Schwarzschild-AdS黑弦解。通过计算Ricci和Kretschmann曲率标量，系统研究了所得解的几何性质。分析揭示了在原点处存在曲率奇点，只要$\kappa$-变形参数满足特定约束，该奇点就会被事件视界所包围。随后，详细考察了各种模型参数对视界结构和构型的影响。评估了这些黑弦的热力学性质；在此方面，自洽地提取了Hawking温度、熵、质量、等压热容和Gibbs自由能。全面探讨了参数，特别是$\kappa$-变形参数，对这些热力学量的影响。此外，证明了这些状态变量从根本上满足扩展的第一定律黑洞热力学，并给出修改的Smarr关系。最后，通过无量纲稀疏度参数探测了Hawking辐射的时间轮廓，借此系统分析了底层参数对量子发射率的影响。
